headline: Island Hop Around Greece
primaryText: Chart your own course across the Ionian, Saronic, Cyclades or Dodecanese, no one else's schedule but yours.
whyItWorks: An aerial shot of a catamaran over turquoise water sells the feeling of freedom before any words are read. The copy speaks to the independent sailor who wants to set their own itinerary, and the line about experienced sailors filters for people who can actually book a bareboat charter. The ad has several versions, which suggests the advertiser is testing and iterating on it.
